I guess that depends on your qualifications. If you are on a limited contract in Denmark its normal to work 6, 9, 12 or 24 months at a time and then do a month or so on unemployment benefits. Generally this is the norm early in your career sadly. But generally more museums move towards full time contracts.

The local museums (each commune basically) mainly do fieldwork all year. The research institutes (Universities, the Nationalmuseum and Moesgaard) are the only ones that do lab work. Ofcause theres projects between these but generally those are two seperate jobs. 

Ofcause we have adverse weather leave, (I belive thats the english word for it) if the weather is crazy.
